stackDivergence.rationale: Task156 value checkpoint: SvxTabStop default/position/copy/assignment, independent mutable scalar lvalues, const borrowed values and position-only ordering are implemented over ordinary JS values. Constructor nul resolves through a field-specific browser system-locale binding using285original decimal resources and306source-projected language-only fallback results, including original numeric language-ID overrides. Native Locale first-name/language/en_US lookup and non-ISO fallback order are preserved; source krm spelling is retained. The system input uses raw browser language (Intl host locale only when unavailable), never current Intl decimal data. General SvtSysLocale/LocaleDataWrapper/LanguageTag service contracts and language-tag canonicalization are not claimed or replaced with fake classes; this is a narrow host/resource binding for the existing real tab consumer. Shared SortedVector is reused; insert/clone/snapshots copy tab values independently, payload equality ignores Which and counted zero spacing deduplicates. Existing unrelated paragraph-adjustment behavior remains unchanged. Full SvxTabStopItem typed Any/merge/hash and moving existing browser JSON APIs to Writer remain pending in this same task. No localized UI labels, ICU implementation, native compiler/probes or new lifetime engine.
